decision.interpretation: URTI cannot provide an own-versus-other patient-profile P3 selectivity test under the frozen direction-agnostic two-group observed-state construction.
decision.reason: Introducing a new signed or contrast-difference P3 would change the frozen observed-state estimand rather than merely repair code.

allowed_secondary_descriptive_quantity.name: prediction_separation
allowed_secondary_descriptive_quantity.restriction: Must not be called P3, must not be used to rescue Level-2/Level-3 primary support, and must not enter the primary P3 Holm family.

manuscript_consequence.URTI_P1: testable once execution inputs are restored
manuscript_consequence.URTI_P2: testable once patient-level bootstrap input is restored
manuscript_consequence.URTI_P3: structurally non-identifiable under frozen design; report as NA, not failed
manuscript_consequence.cross_context_claim: Psoriasis can test explicit multi-syndrome selectivity P3; URTI contributes correspondence evidence through P1/P2 but not the same P3 estimand.
